title: Client Assistance Signup Form
subtitle: Client Assistance workflow to capture interest, available options, readiness, review, and confirmed next steps.
description: An original client assistance signup form for nonprofit operators to preserve assistance request identity, workflow evidence, decisions, exceptions, qualified review, and accountable closeout.
use_case: Use when a nonprofit team must manage a assistance request through the signup workflow while keeping consent, privacy, authority, evidence, escalation, and handoff visible.

sections.title: Client Assistance signup routing
sections.guidance: Identify the record, source, priority, subject, and accountable owner.

blocks.label: Signup identity and routing
blocks.guidance: Use this record ID on attachments, corrections, and follow-up.

blocks.label: Client Assistance identity
blocks.guidance: Preserve the identities used by the controlling program or partner record.

sections.title: Client Assistance signup profile and requested participation
sections.guidance: Define what the person is seeking before treating interest as acceptance.

blocks.label: Client Assistance readiness and record controls
blocks.guidance: Confirm facts and routes; do not infer approval from a checked item.
items: Client-stated need, priorities, and preferred safe contact route are recorded
Only information necessary for service coordination is collected
Consent, release, identity, and household evidence are referenced by status
Immediate danger, abuse, housing, food, health, or legal needs are routed
Eligibility or benefit questions are assigned to the authorized program owner
Language, accessibility, transportation, and communication barriers are identified
Referral consent, partner contact, and information-sharing limits are explicit
Promised service, owner, due point, and client communication are documented

blocks.label: Signup workflow controls
blocks.guidance: Mark each applicable control and route any unmet condition.
items: Signup purpose and requested participation are explicit
Availability and preferred communication are recorded
Requirements and prerequisites are visible before review
Capacity, waitlist, and alternate-option paths are available
No acceptance is implied before authorized review
Next contact, owner, and expected response date are assigned

sections.title: Client Assistance signup options and availability
sections.guidance: Preserve repeated items and the evidence needed to reconstruct the record.

blocks.label: Client Assistance requested options and fit review
blocks.guidance: Use one row per distinct item, activity, commitment, event, or service entry.

blocks.label: Client Assistance evidence review
blocks.guidance: Retain source references and correction history in the approved record.
items: Consent, release, identity, and household evidence are referenced by status
Immediate danger, abuse, housing, food, health, or legal needs are routed

Language, accessibility, transportation, and communication barriers are identified

blocks.label: Decision and authorization basis
items: Requested option and supporting information were reviewed
Capacity, prerequisites, restrictions, and conflicts were considered
Consent, privacy, and qualified-review needs are explicit
Conditions and exclusions are recorded in plain language
The applicant has a defined next step and contact route

sections.title: Client Assistance exceptions and escalation
sections.guidance: Keep incomplete, sensitive, unsafe, disputed, or unauthorized work visible.

blocks.label: Signup authority and record boundary
blocks.guidance: A submitted signup is an expression of interest, not acceptance or authorization. Capacity, prerequisites, consent, privacy, and restrictions require review. This workflow records client-stated needs and service coordination; it does not determine legal rights, medical needs, benefits, or program eligibility. Collect the minimum necessary information, honor safe-contact and consent limits, and route urgent or professional decisions to qualified owners. Hold unresolved work and route it to the qualified owner under applicable policy.

blocks.label: Client Assistance exception triggers
blocks.guidance: Mark each applicable trigger and explain uncertain scope below.
items: Safe contact, identity, consent, or information-sharing scope is uncertain
Immediate danger or urgent health, housing, food, abuse, or safety need is present
Eligibility, benefit, legal, medical, or professional decision is unresolved
Capacity, language, access, transport, funding, or partner gap blocks service
Referral, release, denial, waitlist, or partial-assistance status lacks an owner
Sensitive client information is outside the approved restricted record

blocks.label: Client Assistance unresolved-item register
blocks.guidance: Do not close a row until disposition and accountable ownership are explicit.

sections.title: Client Assistance signup closeout and handoff
sections.guidance: Reconcile the final status, transfer open work, and preserve accountable acceptance.

blocks.label: Client Assistance open actions and limitations
blocks.guidance: Carry forward every item that is not fully resolved at closeout.

blocks.label: Client Assistance handoff confirmations
blocks.guidance: Unchecked items remain part of the open handoff.
items: Final signup status and conditions were communicated
Required records and references were filed
Waitlist or follow-up work retains an owner
Receiving program owner accepted the handoff
No unresolved condition was silently closed
Client-stated need, priority, safe contact, and consent limits were reconciled
Services, referrals, owners, due points, and communication commitments were confirmed
